sources.title: Welcome to Salt
sources.snippet: Welcome to Salt Salt is an AI orchestration platform for regulated enterprises. It unifies models, data, and pipelines with compliance-first architecture, so teams can deploy autonomous AI on their own infrastructure without compromising security or governance.
